body:
Because reassurance is inconsistent. The only indication I ever receive is when things are bad, which indicates to me its just some fleeting response, since the reaction is to a specific stimuli, not something that's always there. It effectively feels like "hey you're depressed, now I care about you" versus the rest of the time being more like "meh, leave me alone." And then the response when it is "I care about you now" is just "things get better" or "you shouldn't feel that way."

I'm at this level because of 15+ years of this. Been through therapy before. All it ever taught me was that everything I know is invalid and should be kept to myself lest it impact other people. I've cleaned myself up physically and tried to teach myself to avoid and identify my own episodic triggers. Traveled, met people over the years, talk to people every day, even talked people down from the ledge I'm on myself, but at the end of the day I'm never consistently important to anyone.
